card.name: Table footnote letters after entries
card.fires_on: Single lowercase letters like a, b or g used as footnote markers, placed right after a table entry or heading in dosing and drug-interaction tables. Also fires on the line break after a table row's final entry.

modes.label: Footnote letter in table
modes.description: A lone letter a, b or g attached to a dose, drug name or column heading as a table footnote marker.
modes.example: Frontalis b 20 Units divided in 4 sites Corrugator<< b>> 10 Units divided in 2

modes.label: Footnote after sentence end
modes.description: A footnote letter that follows a full stop or phrase at the end of a table cell.
modes.example: Interrupt CALQUENCE and/or venetoclax.<< b>> Once toxicity resolves to Grade ≤ 1

card.plain: It marks the small superscript-style letters that point to footnotes in dosing tables.
